title: How many tanks does a salt-bath furnace need? A four-tank configuration example
summary: Salt-bath equipment scope depends on the purpose of each tank. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s proposal dated 15 May 2024 includes one pit salt-bath furnace, a cooling tank, a washing tank and two separate replenishment tanks. Storage tanks do not automatically constitute complete recirculation, cooling or wastewater-treatment systems. Confirm water supply, overflow and downstream-treatment interfaces individually.
